classification.difficultyReason: Find a central angle from three side lengths using the cosine rule, then use that angle in the radian arc-length formula.

content.prompt: A chord of length $5\text{ cm}$ is drawn in a circle with centre $O$ and radius $2\sqrt2\text{ cm}$.

spec.description: Unshaded circle with centre O, lower-left endpoint A and lower-right endpoint B, horizontal chord AB, two labelled radii and matching single ticks. Geometry is constructed from the stated lengths.
spec.mathematics: OA = OB = 2√2 cm and AB = 5 cm. The required arc is the minor arc below chord AB.
spec.answerVisibility: Only supplied labels and equal-radius ticks are visible.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Use the cosine rule to find $\angle AOB$ in radians, correct to 3 d.p.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Hence find the arc length cut off by the chord, correct to 2 d.p.
